## Services
- Preventive & General Dentistry: Check-ups, cleaning, scaling, polishing, fillings
- Cosmetic Dentistry: Teeth whitening, smile design, veneers, aesthetic restorations
- Restorative Dentistry: Root canal treatment (single sitting), crowns, bridges, zirconia
- Dental Implants: Single & multiple tooth implants, implant-supported crowns
- Orthodontic Treatments: Metal & ceramic braces, clear aligners, invisible braces
- Oral Surgery: Painless tooth extraction, wisdom tooth removal
- Pediatric Dentistry: Child-friendly dental care, cavity management
- Gum & Periodontal Care: Deep cleaning, gum therapy, loose teeth treatment
- Emergency Dental Care: Tooth pain, swelling, broken tooth care
